notes: Partition verified: s001-s035 and t001-t043 each appear exactly once.

s014/s015 follow rule 102, a Greek article standing to take the supplied 'thing'; rule 38's 'that very hour' precedent shows an intensive autos does not displace the article's determiner, so rule 49 is not in question.
The repeated 'that' at t022 and t030 are rule 103 helpers on the clauses they introduce and never 'added', hina governing three coordinate clauses.
s019 keeps 'no': schismata is no negative, so rules 41, 59 and 87 leave the negator its own English word.

s026's 'together' rides inside the verb's unit as part of the single lexeme's English expression, headed on 'perfected'; the citation of rule 106 there is looser than the case needs but the unit and head are right.
